parameters.investigationScope: Process file structure compliance with TypeScript type definitions

steps.name: Understand context
steps.output: Context documented: 10 type files, 5 completed processes (18 JSON files), preliminary compliance gaps identified

steps.name: Identify files to review

steps.name: Review, verify, and document

steps.name: Propose fixes
steps.output: All 6 fix categories approved: A (Discriminators), B (Field Names), C (Step IDs), D (Metadata), E (Timestamps), F (Log-Specific)

steps.output: Final summary created: 89% compliance achieved (58/68 issues resolved). Created final-summary.md with executive summary, detailed findings, fix documentation, and recommendations for remaining 7 issues.
